name: qfd_tile_nk_romleaf_rpm-rpm-COMMIT
purpose: A0-REPACK 10-23 (MAIN: ROM pairs back to back (abutted_row), pins into W/E operand channels): re-pack of rc15a (same RTL, children, clocks, REGROOT 9, 0 cycles) into 457.92 x 1157.76 um (0.530 mm2, was 820.8 x 907.2 = 0.745), two tiers: ROM block (5 rows x 2) below an LSL block (3 rows: [node | TX | LSL MY|R0 back to back | TX | LSL]); 20-um channels, no slivers; buses aligned with their consumers; fences moved with their consumers, L9 ring writers FREE.  Plan: tools/qwen_romleaf/repack/gen_repack.py.
